answer.answer: Across this compiled literature set, log(size) and zeta potential show only a very weak, near-null Spearman correlation (rho ≈ -0.07), so size is not a reliable predictor of zeta potential. The signal is swamped by differences in surface chemistry (plain/amine/carboxyl/sulfate, which flips the sign) and suspension medium (DI water vs. salt/culture media, which strongly dampens magnitude).
